cues.en: Let's begin our discussion on probability by talking about histograms, probability densities and the difference between a probability and a proportion.
cues.zh: 機率的討論，先從直方圖、機率密度，以及機率和比例的差異開始。

cues.en: So let's start by talking about this data set here.
cues.zh: 先談這組資料。

cues.en: This is a set of letters.
cues.zh: 是一組字母。

cues.en: And what we want to do is create a histogram from this set.
cues.zh: 要根據它建立直方圖。

cues.en: So creating a histogram from a finite set like this is pretty straightforward.
cues.zh: 對這種有限集合，建立直方圖很直接。

cues.en: All you do is look at all the unique elements in this set and then count the number of occurrences of each element.
cues.zh: 只要找出所有不重複元素，再計算各元素出現幾次。

cues.en: So we have on the X axis the letters A, B and C and on the Y axis, the occurrences or B counts.
cues.zh: x軸是字母a、b、c，y軸是出現次數、計數。

cues.en: So the histogram of this set looks something like this.
cues.zh: 直方圖像這樣。

cues.en: A appears twice, B appears twice, and C appears four times.
cues.zh: a兩次、b兩次、c四次。

cues.en: So pretty straightforward, I think.
cues.zh: 我想很直接。

cues.en: Now here you see a probability plot.
cues.zh: 這裡則是機率圖。

cues.en: Now you'll notice that it looks overall the same.
cues.zh: 可以注意到，整體看起來相同。

cues.en: The main difference is that the Y axis is changed here compared to here.
cues.zh: 主要差異是y軸和那邊不同。

cues.en: So this is in just the raw counts and this is a probability.
cues.zh: 這裡是原始計數，那裡是機率。

cues.en: So A is associated with a probability of point to five or twenty five percent and B also and then C is 50 percent or point five.
cues.zh: a對應0.25、25%的機率，b也一樣，c則50%、0.5。

cues.en: Now, importantly, A probability density has to sum up to one.
cues.zh: 重要的是，機率密度必須加總為1。

cues.en: So all of the values in this entire histogram have to sum up to exactly one.
cues.zh: 所以整張直方圖的所有值，必須正好加總為1。

cues.en: And of course that's the case here.
cues.zh: 這裡當然符合。

cues.en: Point to five plus point twenty five plus point five equals one.
So we have a histogram, we have a probability plot.
cues.zh: 這是直方圖，這是機率圖。

cues.en: And then here I call this a proportion.
cues.zh: 這裡則叫比例。

cues.en: Now, this looks remarkably similar to this probability graph.
cues.zh: 看起來和機率圖非常相似。

cues.en: In fact, in this case, there are exactly the same, except that the interpretation is quite different.
cues.zh: 其實這個情況，完全相同，只是解讀很不一樣。

cues.en: So this y axis here proportion means that A appears 25 percent of the time, B appears 25 percent of the time and C appears 50 percent of the time.
cues.zh: y軸比例表示，a出現25%的次數、b出現25%、c出現50%。

cues.en: Now, that is slightly different from the interpretation of this probability graph here.
cues.zh: 和機率圖的解讀稍微不同。

cues.en: What this means is that if you were to pick a letter totally at random from anywhere in this set, there
cues.zh: 機率圖表示，如果完全隨機從這個集合挑一個字母，

cues.en: is a 25 percent chance that you're going to pick the letter A..
cues.zh: 有25%的機會選到a。

cues.en: So you'll notice that that is a different interpretation from proportion now to make this distinction between probability and proportion a little bit clearer.
cues.zh: 注意，它和比例的解讀不同；為了更清楚區分，

cues.en: Let me show you another example.

cues.zh: 但任一次擲幣，正面的機率是0.5、50%。

cues.en: So here you can see the difference between proportion and probability.
cues.zh: 所以看得出比例與機率的差異。
